capabilities: Insert a daily Bible verse callout into daily notes automatically, via a {{bible-verse}} placeholder, or by command
Re-roll the verse of the day and pin it for that date
Serve verses offline from public-domain translations in German, English, Spanish, French, and Italian
Filter the verse pool by themes or switch to whole-Bible mode with a one-time translation download
Write the verse reference to a frontmatter property and expose a JavaScript API
extras: Not yet in the community directory; installs manually or via BRAT. Whole-Bible mode needs a one-time ~4-5 MB download per translation. KJV carries Crown patent restrictions within the United Kingdom; copyrighted modern translations are deliberately excluded.
problem: Daily notes contain no built-in way to add a daily Scripture verse, and most verse sources require network access or API keys.

relations.evidence: With the core Daily Notes (or Periodic Notes) plugin enabled, every newly created daily note automatically receives the verse callout.

summary: Daily-note plugin that inserts a Bible verse as a callout, from offline public-domain translations in five languages, with themes and re-roll.
